plugin.name: PMEDIA Notifications
plugin.description: Receives generic PMEDIA notification events and renders them through the desktop pet.
config.minSeverity.label: Minimum severity
config.minSeverity.description: Only show notifications at or above this severity.
config.soundEnabled.label: Sound alerts
config.soundEnabled.description: Play sound for warning, error, and urgent notifications.
config.osNotificationEnabled.label: OS notifications
config.osNotificationEnabled.description: Also show an operating system notification when a PMEDIA notification arrives.
config.pollingEnabled.label: Enable polling
config.pollingEnabled.description: Poll enabled PMEDIA sources on a schedule.
config.pollIntervalSeconds.label: Polling interval seconds
config.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll configured sources. Minimum 30 seconds.
config.sources.label: Notification sources
config.sources.description: Direct generic API sources or a PMEDIA Notification Gateway. Source hosts must also be allowed by the plugin manifest.
config.sources.id.label: Source ID
config.sources.id.description: Stable source identifier, for example attendance-prod.
config.sources.type.label: Source type
config.sources.type.description: Use generic-api for PMEDIA backends, notification-gateway for the central gateway, or a special adapter type.
config.sources.name.label: Display name
config.sources.baseUrl.label: Base URL
config.sources.baseUrl.description: HTTPS base URL, for example https://agent-api.pmedia.vn.
config.sources.enabled.label: Enabled
config.sources.enabled.description: Poll this source when polling is enabled.
config.sources.authType.label: Auth type
config.sources.authType.description: Authentication mode. Token storage is reserved for the next phase.

command.clearSeen.title: Clear PMEDIA notification cache
command.clearSeen.description: Clear local dedupe/history cache for PMEDIA notification testing.
